title: Upper Density Theorem in μHE[n]-a.e. limit form (Simon 1.3.6)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ν any measure on (the Borel sets of) ℝ^{n+ℓ}, and A a Borel set with ν(A) < ∞. Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∉ A, ρ⁻ⁿ·ν(A ∩ B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the closed ball and the quotient is taken in ℝ, i.e. it is (ρⁿ)⁻¹·ν.real(A ∩ B_ρ(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (A : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet A → ν A < ∞ → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)), x ∉ A → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ν.real (A ∩ closedBall x ρ)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
